messages.sourceEnglish: Confirm a mapped site’s country before using its crop-planning guidance.
messages.text: Tiyisisa tiko ra ndhawu leyi mepiweke u nga si tirhisa nkongomiso wa yona wo kunguhata swibyariwa.

messages.sourceEnglish: Keep your sowing records and nursery equipment while local planning is unavailable.
messages.text: Hlayisa matsalwa ya wena yo byala na switirhisiwa swa narsari loko kungu ra laha kaya ri nga si kumeka.
Tiyisisa tiko ra ndhawu ya wena

messages.sourceEnglish: Crop planner → Site country and region
messages.text: Mukunguhati wa swibyariwa → Tiko ra ndhawu na xifundzha

messages.sourceEnglish: Open your mapped site and confirm its country details. Country confirmation does not approve farming advice for a new region.
messages.text: Pfula ndhawu ya wena leyi mepiweke kutani u tiyisisa vuxokoxoko bya tiko ra yona. Ku tiyisisa tiko a swi pasisi switsundzuxo swo rima swa xifundzha lexintshwa.

messages.sourceEnglish: Crop planner → Planning without a mapped site
messages.text: Mukunguhati wa swibyariwa → Ku kunguhata handle ka ndhawu leyi mepiweke

messages.sourceEnglish: For a virtual bed or local design, explicitly choose or remove the South African reference basis. The choice stays with that workspace.
messages.text: Eka bedi ro vumbiwa kumbe dizayini ya laha kaya, hlawula kumbe u susa xisekelo xo komba xa Afrika-Dzonga hi ku kongoma. Nhlawulo wu ta sala na ndhawu yoleyo yo tirhela.
